title: Layers
harmonizedHistoryExplain: Fire days per 0.25 degree cell for one year, from the harmonized record.
harmonizedHistoryTime: {year}, counted over the whole year. {cells} cells had fire.
recentFiresExplain: Satellite detections from the last day or week. These rows carry no fire type, so industrial heat sources such as gas flares cannot be removed yet.
recentFiresTimeCapped: Showing {shown} of {total} detections, the strongest by heat output, from {from} to {to} UTC.
fireDangerExplain: The fire weather index, as the Copernicus service forecasts it for one day.
failed: This layer could not be read just now.
noRecent: No detections passed the confidence rule in this period.
mergedNote: Zoomed out, each square covers several cells and takes the colour of the worst one. Zoom in to see every cell.
nasaFwi: NASA fire-weather index (as shown in GWIS), experimental
nasaFwiExplain: Fire weather index, dimensionless. No data where the service has no coverage.
soilMoistureExplain: Soil moisture (m³/m³); gaps are satellite coverage. No data in gaps.
greennessExplain: NDVI, dimensionless. No data where observations are missing.
landTypeExplain: IGBP land cover classes. No data where observations are missing.
airTemperature: Air temperature (satellite pass, gaps between passes)
airTemperatureExplain: Surface air temperature in kelvin. No data between satellite passes.
driverLegend: See the provider colours on the map.
landLegend: Forest; shrub and grass; farmland; other.
windExplain: Arrows show wind direction; speed in km/h. No data if the service cannot be reached.
historyCredit: NASA FIRMS (MODIS and VIIRS active fire data), harmonized by this project
recentCredit: NASA FIRMS near-real-time active fire data (MODIS and VIIRS)
